text:
maria: Heads up — GCP APAC H100 spot/on-demand baseline came through ~27% higher in this morning's billing feed. Looks like the unit-cost delta vs our committed rate is material. Can infra/finance triage impact on Dedicated and Hosted unit economics? :eyes:

ajay: saw the alert, running a quick delta now. Early rough: about +$0.42 / vGPU-hour vs our plan which balloons unit token cost for long seq workloads. I'll spreadsheet it and share.

kyle: infra notes — autoscaler already started replacing preemptibles in asia-east1 last night due to capacity churn, so our real exposure may be a mix of on-demand and replacement instances. Current committed utilization in APAC is ~68% for H100 pool (we sized yesterday at 2.8k reserved hours/day).

sarah: product — if this holds we'll need to evaluate two things fast: 1) temporary price protection for existing customers, 2) pause new Dedicated sales in APAC until we rebalance. Need a margin swing table by packaging tier (Starter/Pro/Enterprise).

leo: engineering: routing can fall back to quantized LLM variants or H200-S at slightly worse latency. For chat-heavy endpoints the latency hit is small; for long-form generation token cost is the primary concern. We should estimate perf & quality delta for top 10 customer models.

ajay: sharing quick calc (placeholder sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 — putting in a simple per-token delta model. Quick snippet: 
```
# rough per-token cost change (toy calc)
old_gpu_hour = 0.015  # $ per 1k tokens equivalent at old rates
new_gpu_hour = 0.019  # after billing feed spike
delta = (new_gpu_hour - old_gpu_hour) / old_gpu_hour * 100
# delta ~= 26.7%
```

ana: ops-bot: Billing alert: project/redwood-prod/apac-gpu > threshold (27% increase) — ticket created #BILL-4312.

ana (ana?): Sorry typo — ana here (finance). Action items from my side: 1) run full Q3 unit-econ reprice using updated cloud SKU feeds, 2) check committed-use discount terms and early-exit/retrocommit clauses for APAC regions, 3) model pass-through vs absorb scenarios for each packaging tier. ETA EOD for a first pass.

kyle: infra action items: estimate cost to shift X% of routing to H200-S / quantized instances (including perf regression ops cost). Also evaluate short-term capacity buffer from our committed pool vs regional egress and network pricing differences. Will post numbers in #infra-costs channel.

maria: great. quick checklist so this thread doesn't get lost: 
- ajay: rerun per-customer unit-econ with new SKUs and link to sheet (EOD)
- ana: legal/finance check on commitment clauses and suggestion on converting on-demand to commit (tomorrow AM)
- kyle: capacity-shift cost & perf tradeoffs (ETD 6h)
- leo: run perf/quality benchmarks for fallback variants on representative prompts (24h)
- sarah: hold messaging for Enterprise sales until we have concrete numbers; draft contingency pricing options.

maria: temporary mitigation proposals welcome here. If anyone thinks we should cut APAC Dedicated sales today, say so.

sarah: :thinking_face: recommend an immediate hold on new Dedicated onboarding in APAC for 48h until we validate margins. We can whitelist existing contracts.

leo: +1 on hold. We can spin up additional quantized routes within hours, but need SLO/monitoring for quality regression.

ajay: running sensitivity: will include worst-case (+40%) and best-case (+10%) scenarios. Linking results when ready.

ana (ops-bot): Reminder — please attach any customer-impacting notes to #BILL-4312 ticket.

maria: thanks all — we'll regroup at 15:00 UTC for a short sync once first-pass numbers are in. 

(Reaction summary: :eyes: on root message, :thumbsup: from kyle & leo, :raise_hand: from ana)
